meta.name: stakeholder-mapping
meta.description: Prioritize stakeholders using two complementary grids. Use when setting engagement strategy and surfacing whose voice needs elevating after stakeholder identification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用双网格矩阵排序利益相关者优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目早期识别并排序关键利益相关者
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize stakeholders using two complementary grids
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify and prioritize key stakeholders early in a project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用两个互补的 2x2 矩阵（权力×利益、影响×权力）对利益相关者进行优先级排序，并对比两个矩阵的结果，找出被忽视的高影响低权力群体，然后规划如何调整参与策略。
howto.when: 当你完成利益相关者识别后，需要决定如何分配参与资源，或准备参与策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我用两个矩阵分析这14个利益相关者，附上角色备注。
say.note: Claude 会运行两个矩阵并对比结果。

say.text: 对比权力×利益和影响×权力矩阵，找出被忽视的群体。
say.note: Claude 会揭示两个矩阵的差异点。

howto.what_en: Claude runs two complementary 2x2 grids (Power × Interest, Impact × Power) to prioritize stakeholders, compares outputs to surface high-impact low-power groups, and plans quadrant migration.
howto.when_en: Triggered after stakeholder identification, when you need to decide engagement strategy or prepare for a review.

say_en.text: Analyze these 14 stakeholders using both grids, with role notes attached.
say_en.note: Claude runs both grids and compares results.

say_en.text: Compare Power×Interest and Impact×Power grids to find overlooked groups.
say_en.note: Claude reveals gaps between the two grids.
